business_problem: Sequanta Technologies needed to accelerate genome, methylation, and single-cell analysis across large sequencing and multi-omics workloads, but CPU-era pipelines left data analysis as a bottleneck for both research and patient-facing turnaround times.
solution_summary: Sequanta built its production analysis stack on NVIDIA Parabricks, RAPIDS, and T4 GPUs so data from distributed sequencing labs can move from raw reads to downstream insight much faster. Parabricks replaces slow secondary-analysis stages for WES and WGS with GPU-accelerated versions of trusted open-source tools, while Parabricks BWA-Meth speeds bisulfite-sequencing alignment for methylation studies on large datasets. For tertiary analytics, RAPIDS shortens single-cell preprocessing from tens of minutes to seconds, allowing the company to keep pace with the 1.5 petabytes of data generated each month across its labs. That architecture lets Sequanta offer a full wet-lab-to-dry-lab service model in which large genomics, multi-omics, and methylation workloads are processed on one GPU-accelerated platform rather than through separate slow CPU pipelines.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA Parabricks
solution_components.role: Accelerates WES and WGS secondary analysis with GPU versions of standard genomics tools.

solution_components.name: Parabricks BWA-Meth
solution_components.role: Handles GPU-accelerated methylation alignment for bisulfite sequencing workflows.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA RAPIDS
solution_components.role: Speeds tertiary data-science steps such as single-cell preprocessing on large biological datasets.

solution_components.name: NVIDIA T4 GPUs
solution_components.role: Provide the GPU hardware Sequanta uses to run accelerated genomics and multi-omics pipelines.

data_flow: Reads from Sequanta's sequencing labs enter Parabricks for GPU-accelerated WES and WGS processing, bisulfite datasets are aligned with Parabricks BWA-Meth, and downstream single-cell analyses move through RAPIDS on T4-backed systems before results are returned to research and clinical customers.
business_outcome: Sequanta reduced WGS runtime from 7 hours to 31 minutes and 5 seconds, cut WES to 2 minutes and 37 seconds, improved methylation alignment 21x, and accelerated single-cell preprocessing about 101x, turning analysis speed into a competitive advantage for its multi-omics services.
metrics: more than 1.5 petabytes of data every month
architecture_clues: Sequanta operates 10 sequencing laboratories across China
The company has conducted more than 300 cohorts since 2021 through its multi-omics business
T4 GPUs back both methylation and broader genomics acceleration
RAPIDS is used for tertiary analysis alongside Parabricks secondary analysis
evidence_quotes: With Parabricks, Sequanta Technologies was able to reduce whole-genome sequencing (WGS) from 7 hours to 31 minutes and 5 seconds-almost 14x faster than CPU.
Using eight NVIDIA T4 GPUs and the GPU-accelerated version of BWA-Meth in Parabricks, alignment runtime decreased to only 1 hour.
This resulted in a 21x acceleration improvement using Parabricks for methylation alignment versus the traditional method.
With Scanpy, preprocessing took 37 minutes to complete, and with CUDA-X DS, the step took ~22 seconds-almost a 101x speedup.
